title: SpaceX Stock (SPCX) Rises 8.6% as AI Stocks Rebound (Nov 6)
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) rose 8.62% to close at $134.27 on Nov 6 as AI-linked stocks rebounded from a post-midterm selloff, with no company news behind the move.
body_markdown:
## Why SpaceX Stock Rose


No company-specific news explains the gain. According to[TIKR](https://www.tikr.com/blog/spacex-soars-6-as-ai-stocks-rebound-from-420-billion-post-midterm-musk-selloff) , "SpaceX didn't announce anything that explains the jump," and the stock instead moved with AI-linked shares as they rebounded on November 6. TIKR reported that investors bought back stocks they had sold on fears that Democrats would slow data-center approvals, with chip suppliers leading the bounce.


The rebound followed a sharp two-day slide. SpaceX[fell 9% on Thursday](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/spacex-spcx-stock-news-november-6-2026/) , and TIKR said SpaceX and Tesla together lost more than $420 billion in market value over the two days after Tuesday's Democratic sweep of Congress. TIKR added that "SpaceX had no news of its own, and the risks behind the drop are still in place."


TIKR also pointed to how much of SpaceX's business now rides on AI: its AI segment, Super Intelligence, brought in $7.6 billion of the company's $14.6 billion in third-quarter revenue.


## SPCX Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Management view on compute returns: on its October 20 third-quarter[earnings call](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) , SpaceX's CFO said new compute deployments pay back in "less than a year," and that pricing ran slightly above the top of the $30 to $50 per-watt range discussed the quarter before, as reported by[Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/ai-power-stocks-just-fell-145500327.html) . This is the company's own claim.
- Cash on hand: SpaceX held $89.9 billion in cash and marketable securities as of September 30, per TIKR.


### Risks


- Heavy spending and financing: management guides fourth-quarter capital spending to $35 billion to $40 billion, and Bloomberg reported that SpaceX's banks are shopping pieces of a roughly $40 billion chip financing to investors, per TIKR. The cost to insure SpaceX's debt against default hit a record during the selloff.
- Data-center politics: Democrat Gina Hinojosa won the Texas governor's race on a promise of a data-center moratorium, and Wells Fargo puts 27% of planned US data-center capacity in Texas, where SpaceX has projects, TIKR noted. The moratorium is still a campaign promise.


Next on the calendar, SpaceX will try to launch its Starship rocket again on November 13, according to[Barron's](https://finance.yahoo.com/m/66c4c895-64c7-3dea-b009-84beec2bd6d0/spacex-schedules-starship.html) .
